name: codeql-format-string-user-controlled-data
hook: CodeQL flags console.error with template literals using user data
body:
CodeQL flags `console.error(`[msg] ${userData}`, err)` as a user-controlled format string vulnerability. The fix is to use separate arguments: `console.error('[msg]', userData, ':', err)`.

**Why:** Template literals with user-controlled data in console.error/create issues allow format string attacks. Using separate arguments avoids this.

**How to apply:** When CodeQL reports "javascript/eslint-plugin/codeql/diagnostics/format-stringInjection" on a console.error call, convert the template literal to separate arguments.
